summary.headline: Horary Questions, 31–52
summary.text: Continuation of a catalog of astrological questions, covering travel, agreements, high priesthood, rain, inheritance, illness and confinement, death, treasures, royal benefit, death timing, war, requests, love, and the years and death times inferred from horary signs and lots. Cross-references cite codex 7 and folios 43v, 64v, 184v, 206, and 206v.
